name: Vayne
notes: Opens by casting Final Hour (R) at t=0: it has no cast time, so it does not delay the first attack beyond the usual 0.25 s opening lockout, and it grants bonus AD plus a Tumble cooldown reduction for its duration.

Tumble (Q) is cast on cooldown: it resets the attack timer (the next attack follows one windup later) and arms that attack with bonus physical damage, tagged as spell damage so it does not critically strike; the short dash's own post-effect delay before the cooldown starts is not modeled separately, it is treated as starting at the cast.

Silver Bolts (W) has no cooldown: every on-hit application from an attack or from Condemn adds a stack, and the third stack consumes all three for true damage based on the target's maximum health (or the flat floor, whichever is larger).

Condemn (E) is cast on cooldown for its own physical damage and to add a Silver Bolts stack; its 0.25 s cast time delays the next attack by the usual cast lockout and its damage lands when the cast ends.

Condemn's terrain-collision bonus damage and stun are not modeled: the dummy fight has no terrain behind the target, so only the base hit is dealt (the higher-damage assumption was rejected as it requires terrain that does not exist here).
Final Hour's bonus AD and Tumble cooldown reduction only apply while its duration is running; its cooldown far exceeds the fight length, so it is cast once at the opening and never recast.
Mana is not modeled: none of Vayne's costs double or otherwise plausibly stall Q/E/R inside a short fight at level 16.
